questions.text: Which city has Kazakhstan's only metro system?
questions.hint: "Almaty has the only metro system in Kazakhstan."

questions.text: A metro journey in Almaty costs about 100 tenge.
questions.hint: "a single journey costs only about 100 tenge"

questions.text: How long does a train journey from Uralsk to Almaty take?
questions.hint: "A journey from Uralsk to Almaty takes about 24 hours by train."

questions.text: Oral Airport is about ___ kilometres from Uralsk city centre.
questions.hint: "Oral Airport, located about 6 kilometres from the city centre."

questions.text: Cycling in Kazakhstan is popular in winter.
questions.hint: "cycling in winter — temperatures can drop to minus 30 — is not practical!"

questions.text: How early should you arrive for a domestic flight at Oral Airport?
questions.hint: "arrive at the airport at least one hour and thirty minutes before departure"

questions.text: There is a direct public bus from WKU to Oral Airport.
questions.hint: "There is currently no direct public bus route to Oral Airport."

questions.text: What document do you receive after airport check-in?
questions.hint: "The check-in agent will give you a boarding pass."

questions.text: What time zone does Uralsk use?
questions.hint: "Uralsk (West Kazakhstan) uses UTC+5"

questions.text: In the dialogue, Rustam's flight to Aktobe departs at ___.
questions.hint: "My flight is at 11:00."

questions.text: Rustam was walking in the correct direction when he asked.
questions.hint: "you're going in the wrong direction, I'm afraid"

questions.text: What colour is the museum building?
questions.hint: "the large grey building directly opposite"

questions.text: The museum is open on Mondays.
questions.hint: "I believe it's closed on Mondays."

questions.text: What landmark is at the roundabout?
opts: A tall blue building (the post office)
questions.correct: A tall blue building (the post office)
questions.hint: "a tall blue building on the corner. That's the main post office."

questions.text: The woman says: "You can't ___ it!" — meaning it's very easy to find.
questions.hint: "You can't miss it" = you will definitely see it.

questions.text: Which is a correct imperative?
questions.hint: Imperative = base verb, no subject, no -ing, no "to".

questions.text: ___ miss your stop — set an alarm!
questions.hint: Negative imperative = Don't + base verb.

questions.text: "___ take the metro — it's faster!" = a shared suggestion.
questions.hint: Let's = suggestion for both people.

questions.text: "Get ___ the bus at the WKU stop."
questions.hint: Bus = large vehicle → get ON.

questions.text: "Get ___ the taxi — the driver is here!"
questions.hint: Taxi = small vehicle → get IN.

questions.text: I travel to Almaty ___ plane twice a year.
questions.hint: "by + transport": by plane, by train, by car.

questions.text: "Walk ___ the bridge" = go from one side to the other.
questions.hint: Across = from one side to the other.

questions.text: "She ___ the last bus and had to walk." = failed to catch it.
questions.hint: miss the bus = arrive too late to catch it.

questions.text: "I travel by foot" is the correct English expression.
questions.hint: The correct expression is "on foot", not "by foot".

questions.text: What does "fare" mean?
opts: The price you pay to travel on public transport
questions.correct: The price you pay to travel on public transport
questions.hint: Fare = the cost of a journey on public transport.

questions.text: Always check the bus ___ so you don't miss the last service.
questions.hint: Schedule = a timetable of departure times.

questions.text: What is a "boarding pass"?
opts: A document showing your seat and gate for a flight
questions.correct: A document showing your seat and gate for a flight
questions.hint: Boarding pass = given at check-in; shows seat number and gate.

questions.text: "Overweight" luggage means lighter than allowed.
questions.hint: Overweight = HEAVIER than the allowed maximum. You pay extra.

questions.text: What does "affordable" mean?
questions.hint: Affordable = cheap enough to be within most people's budget.

questions.text: A "route" in transport means...
opts: The path from one place to another
questions.correct: The path from one place to another
questions.hint: Route = the path or way taken to travel from A to B.
